title: Assessment Administration Coordinator
description:
Assessment Administration Coordinator

Location: Nominal office of York, with expected minimum attendance of once per month
Salary: £27,010 gross per annum
Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Applications close on 14th September at 9am. Interviews will take place via MS Teams w/c 28th September

Benefits:
- A generous pension plan with USS
- Enhanced family leave benefits
- 31 days annual leave, plus bank holidays
- Flexible working hours
- Hybrid work
- Employee Assistance Programme access
- Personal Financial Wellbeing advice access

to name a few

The Role:

We are looking for an Assessment Administration Coordinator to support the delivery of a range of prestigious peer review and assessment services across the higher education sector.

This role will provide end-to-end administrative support for either institutional services (including Athena Swan, Race Equality Charter, Inclusive Institutions Framework, Impact Awards and Accreditation) or individual services (including Fellowship, End-Point Assessment and Awards).

You will play a vital role in ensuring assessment processes run smoothly, efficiently and accurately, supporting applicants, reviewers, institutions and subject experts throughout the assessment journey.

Working within a collaborative team, you will help deliver excellent customer experiences while contributing to ongoing service improvements and transformation projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys coordinating multiple priorities and has a strong commitment to quality, accuracy and continuous improvement.

There are 3 opportunities available for this role, 1 permanent position within Institutional Services and 2 Fixed Term Contracts within Individual Services.

Job requirements
- Experience delivering high-quality administrative support within education or a related professional environment.
- Proven experience delivering excellent customer service and handling customer enquiries and complaints.
- Experience working with databases, CRM systems and case management systems.
- Experience using multiple digital systems to record, manage and monitor data accurately.
- Experience supporting external customers and stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.
- Knowledge and experience of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- Experience managing confidential and sensitive information appropriately.

Job responsibilities

Assessment Process Administration
- Support the effective administration of end-to-end peer review assessment processes across both institutional and individual services.
- Conduct initial quality assurance checks on applications to ensure eligibility requirements and submission standards are met prior to review.
- Coordinate assessment activities and ensure results are released accurately and within published timescales.
- Provide administrative support for assessment panels, peer review meetings and reviewer activities.
- Prepare, issue and manage assessment outcomes, feedback documentation and certification for successful applicants.
- Maintain accurate records and data throughout the assessment lifecycle in accordance with compliance requirements and service standards.
- Support the administration of peer reviewers, consultants and other associates involved in assessment delivery.

Customer Service and Stakeholder Support
- Respond to application and post-recognition enquiries in a timely, professional and customer-focused manner.
- Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining a positive customer experience.
- Build strong working relationships with institutional contacts, contract holders, programme leaders, programme administrators and subject expert teams.
- Support a seamless customer and member experience across all assessment services.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, services, systems and processes to provide accurate guidance and support.

Data Management and Reporting
- Maintain and monitor information within databases, CRM systems and assessment platforms.
- Produce reports and administrative data to support operational monitoring and service delivery.
- Support annual HESA and international data returns where applicable.
- Ensure all records are accurate, secure and compliant with GDPR and organisational policies.

Continuous Improvement and Transformation
- Contribute ideas to improve administrative efficiency and enhance customer experiences.
- Support assessment delivery transformation projects, including system testing, piloting and process improvements.
- Actively contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
- Keep process documentation up to date and support the implementation of new systems and ways of working.

Compliance and Governance
- Ensure policies, procedures and regulatory requirements are consistently followed.
- Uphold organisational commitments relating to equality, diversity and inclusion, data protection, health and safety and charity governance.
- Handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

What you'll get

You'll have the opportunity to shape how finance supports the organisation, influence decision-making at all levels, and lead a team committed to delivering an excellent service. In return, you'll join a collaborative and values-driven organisation where your expertise, leadership and ideas will make a real difference.

If you're an experienced finance professional who combines strong operational leadership with a passion for developing people and improving processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Advance HE is a member-led, sector-owned charity that works with institutions and higher education across the world to improve higher education for staff, students and society.

Our strategic priorities of: maximising membership impact and value, supporting leadership, management and governance development for transformational change and developing educational excellence for the higher education of the future supports the work of our members and the sector.

It is our people and the people we help that really make us who we are!

To apply:

If you have the skills and experience required for this role, please click on Apply today to be taken to our site to complete your application.

Advance HE is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone regardless of their background.

No agencies please.

title: Training and Recruitment administrator
company: Ashley Kate HR & Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Training and Recruitment Coordinator

Location: Harrogate
Salary: Up to 33,000
Benefits: Company car, 27 days holiday + bank holidays, pension, life assurance and employee benefits
Hours: Full-time, with flexible start/finish times

The Role

Ashley Kate are pleased to be supporting our client in the search for a Training and Recruitment Coordinator based in Harrogate.
This is a varied role responsible for coordinating recruitment, onboarding and training activity across a large operational workforce. You will work closely with the Training Manager and hiring managers across multiple locations, with travel required approximately 2-3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the end-to-end recruitment process for operational and technical vacancies.
- Arrange interviews and liaise with candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
- Coordinate new starter onboarding and inductions.
- Support pre-employment processes, including drug and alcohol testing.
- Work closely with operational and engineering managers on recruitment requirements and interviews.
- Maintain accurate recruitment records and documentation.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of recruitment systems and processes.
- Provide general recruitment and training coordination and administration.

About You
- Previous recruitment, recruitment coordination or similar experience.
- Experience within a high-volume or operational recruitment environment would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to manage multiple vacancies and priorities effectively.
- Confident working independently and taking ownership of recruitment activity.
- Comfortable travelling regularly between regional sites.
- Experience recruiting within transport, logistics, engineering, care or another high-volume environment would be beneficial.

Benefits
- Salary up to 33,000.
- Company car - electric vehicle.
- 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Pension scheme.
- Life assurance at 2x salary.
- Employee discount benefits.
- Flexible working hours.
- Additional employee travel benefits.

Please contact Alice Connors on (phone number removed) to discuss further

About Us

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Are you a proactive and confident Office Administrator who enjoys working in a busy, sociable environment where no two days are quite the same?

Would you like to join a growing financial services business in Pickering, where you ll be trusted to manage your own workload, build relationships with clients and develop your knowledge along the way?

We are looking for an organised and personable Office Administrator to join our client s friendly, open-plan office.

This is a permanent opportunity offering plenty of variety. You ll be working with different systems, communicating regularly with clients and supporting the team with the administration needed to keep client records accurate, compliant and up to date.

You don t need to know everything about the industry day one. What s important is that you re proactive, confident communicating with people and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You ll receive training and development to build your understanding of the legislation and compliance and reporting as your job evolves.

The office is busy, chatty and collaborative, with a relaxed dress code and it s dog friendly too!

What the Office Administrator job involves

You ll provide day-to-day administrative support to the team while helping to ensure clients receive an efficient and professional service.
- Completing and processing client forms and documentation.
- Contacting clients to chase outstanding information, documents and signatures.
- Ensuring the required documentation is received and recorded for compliance purposes.
- Keeping client information and records accurate and up to date.
- Using a number of different systems to manage information and administrative processes.
- Creating reports and letters from templates to send to clients.
- Communicating confidently with clients by telephone and email.

This role would suit someone who enjoys taking responsibility for their work rather than waiting to be given their next task.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is organised, approachable and comfortable working in a busy environment. You ll ideally have:
- Previous administration experience is essential.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A proactive approach and the confidence to use your own initiative.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence speaking with people over the phone.
- The ability to self-manage and prioritise a varied workload.
- Good IT skills and the ability to learn and work across several different systems.
- A professional approach when handling confidential information.

Other information
- Full time working 8:30am 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am 1:30pm Friday
- 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Your birthday off.
- Lunch provided each day.
- Access to free financial advice.
- Performance-related end-of-year bonus.
- Training and development including paid for professional qualifications.
- A friendly, open-plan and dog-friendly working environment.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data. If you would like to read our privacy policy, please go to our website where you will find all the information you need to know about how we will use and process your personal data.

You can also follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn for up to date jobs and other helpful information.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Knaresborough, North Yorkshire
£26,000 to £30,000 depending on experience
Full-time, Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, fully office based

Benefits: Generous annual bonus scheme, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, additional annual leave with length of service, private medical insurance, life assurance, income protection, enhanced employer pension contribution, enhanced maternity and paternity pay, employee discounts and lifestyle benefits platform, wellbeing support services, two paid volunteering days per year, ClassPass credits, ongoing training and development and genuine opportunities for career progression.

This is a newly created role within a rapidly growing organisation, offering an excellent opportunity to join an expanding HR function and work closely with an experienced Head of HR.

With wide exposure across HR, this role offers plenty of variety and the chance to make the position your own as it evolves. You'll receive ongoing training and development, making it ideal for an experienced HR Administrator or someone looking to build a long-term career within HR in a supportive and forward-thinking business.

HR Administrator Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinating recruitment activities, including arranging interviews and liaising with candidates, hiring managers and recruitment partners
- Preparing employment contracts, offer letters and right-to-work documentation
- Supporting onboarding and offboarding processes
- Maintaining accurate employee records and HR systems
- Assisting with payroll and employee benefits administration
- Responding to employee queries and providing day-to-day HR support
- Supporting HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives
- Working collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure HR processes run smoothly

Candidate Requirements:
- Previous HR administration experience would be advantageous, although we would also welcome applications from candidates with strong administrative experience and a genuine interest in pursuing a career in HR
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail
- Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively
- Professional, discreet and comfortable handling confidential information
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office and learning new systems
- Proactive, positive and keen to develop professionally

To Apply

Please submit your CV via the link or contact Beth Davies at Unity Resourcing for more information.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Our client is a well established and growing business looking to strengthen its finance team with the addition of a Finance Assistant.
This role will support the Finance Manager across a range of transactional finance and month end activities whilst working within a collaborative and supportive finance team based in Harrogate.
We feel this role would suit an engaging individual at the early stages of their finance career who is looking to develop their skills within a successful and expanding organisation.
Main duties of the role:
- Bank reconciliations
- Ledger reconciliations across multiple entities and accounts
- Accounts payable including invoice processing, statement reconciliations and payment runs
- Preparing payroll schedules
- Processing intercompany transactions
- Supplier statement reviews
- Ensuring the accuracy of financial transactions, charges and account balances
- Assisting with month-end processes including accruals, prepayments and reporting
- Producing reports for internal review and analysis

Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 plus benefits
IPS Finance has over 40 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long-term relationships with both individuals and clients across all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. Please visit our website to view the latest accountancy, finance and practice opportunities.

title: Administrator
company: Tees Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Tees Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking to recruit a part-time, experienced administrator to join our friendly front of-house team based at Eastfield Clinic, Scarborough. Eastfield Clinic is an Adult Learning Disabilities base providing care, support, and information to people in the local community, there is free car parking available to staff. As an essential part of the reception team, you will be the first point of contact for Service Users, Carers, Staff and External Partners Whilst having previous experience in a customer service role is essential, NHS or other health care experience is desirable. We are first and foremost looking for a colleague with a passion for helping people who believes in delivering excellent customer service, who has a keen interest in learning and working in a health care setting with a 'can do' attitude. The post is 18 hours per week and will support the Adult Learning Disabilities at Eastfield Clinic. You must have the Right to Work in the UK in order to be successfully appointed to this role. Please note, this role does not meet the required eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa and therefore the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular role. The main duties will require you to greet service users, carers, and external partners face to face including answering queries via telephone. The role will involve dealing with incoming and outgoing post, room bookings, order stationery, logging calls with estates, dealing with prescriptions, petty cash, booking taxis or patient transport, arranging collection of pathology samples, and general office duties. The ability to remain calm, communicate clearly, adhere to confidentiality, and promote a positive culture for those living with mental health issues and/or learning disabilities. The successful candidate will be expected to perform basic admin tasks, update clinic lists, maintain visitor logs, issue access cards, deal with incoming and outgoing post, support accurate data inputting onto the Trust patient database and ensuring that all information in the reception area for staff and the public is clearly displayed and updated as appropriate. For more details, please read carefully the job description. To be successful at shortlisting please briefly describe how you match this description citing examples to reinforce your experience. Please note we are unable to shortlist those who do not match the essential criteria. Our Trust is dedicated to supporting our colleagues in providing an excellent working environment and encourages everyone to share their progressive ideas. All staff have regular 1-2-1 supervisions and an annual appraisal, which provides lots of opportunity for celebration of achievements, and discussions around challenges, and your aspirations. You will work with established reception staff and be supported by the wider admin team. If successful you will be supplied with a job plan and a fully supported induction. For an informal discussion or to arrange a visit to Eastfield Clinic, please call: 01723 580 940 This is a rewarding role working in a desirable team, if you feel this is the challenge for you then we very much look forward to receiving your application. Please refer to the attached job description and person specification for further detailed information to ensure that you meet the role criteria before applying. This job advert may close early if a high volume of applications have been received. If interested, please apply for this post as soon as possible.
